# Models & Routing Overview

OpenRouter provides powerful routing capabilities to ensure your requests are handled by the best available models and providers.

## Key Routing Features

- **Auto Model Selection**: Automatically select the best model for your prompt.
- **Model Fallbacks**: Failover to backup models if your primary choice is unavailable.
- **Provider Selection**: Intelligently route requests across multiple providers.
- **Model Variants**: Specialized versions of models for free access, extended context, and more.
